body: Upon further investigation I have realised that the texture RID was garbage collected by the RenderSceneBuffers. In RenderSceneBuffersRD docs it specifically says: 'Buffers are only guaranteed to exist during rendering of the viewport', I'm assuming that's why the context in which it was stored was cleared on resizing. To solve this, I managed the RID manually; making sure to set the Texture2DRD `texture_rd_rid` property to `RID()` before creating a new texture from scratch using `rd.texture_create` and assigning the RID of said texture to the Texture2DRD `texture_rd_rid` property. The errors arose because the shader material was using a texture2DRD that was attempting to access an RID that no longer existed.
